name: Britannic Empire
alt: Britannic Empire of Carausius and Allectus

predecessors.name: Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Britain and northern Gaul, taken from Maximian's and Diocletian's empire when Carausius 'usurped power in 286'

successors.name: Roman Empire
successors.text: Britain, retaken in 296 by Constantius Chlorus's subordinate Julius Asclepiodotus after the landing near Southampton Water

ledger.x: 286: Carausius declares himself emperor in Britain and northern Gaul.
293: Constantius Chlorus retakes the Gallic territory.
293: Allectus assassinates Carausius and takes command; the state continues under the same name and land.
296: Britain returns to the Roman Empire after ten years.

wars.name: Carausian Revolt
wars.outcome: Roman victory: Constantius retook the Gallic territory and Boulogne in 293, Carausius was assassinated by Allectus in 293, and Constantius and Asclepiodotus retook Britain in 296, Allectus being killed in battle.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary: Britain is a province-wide reading ('suggests he controlled all of Roman Britain') and the Gallic coast is a reading of 'northern Gaul'.
